name: VegaVend Merchant Connector
author: VegaVend

sections.description:
The VegaVend Merchant Connector plugin allows WooCommerce store owners to easily integrate and synchronize their products with the VegaVend marketplace. This plugin provides a seamless connection between your WooCommerce store and VegaVend, enabling you to manage your products, orders, and account status directly from your WordPress admin dashboard.

Data Privacy

When using this plugin, data is sent to and received from the following endpoints:

  • https://vegavend.com/wp-json/vegavend-store-api/v1/get-categories – Fetches product categories from VegaVend.
  • https://vegavend.com/wp-json/vegavend-store-api/v1/products – Syncs product data with VegaVend.
  • https://vegavend.com/wp-json/vegavend-store-api/v1/get_product_status_report – Fetches product status report from VegaVend.
  • https://vegavend.com/wp-json/vegavend-store-api/v1/get_subscription_report – Fetches subscription report from VegaVend.
  • https://vegavend.com/wp-json/vegavend-store-api/v1/get_product_issues – Fetches product issues data from VegaVend.
  • https://vegavend.com/wp-json/vegavend-store-api/v1/orders – Creates orders in WooCommerce from VegaVend.
  • https://vegavend.com/wp-json/vegavend-store-api/v1/accounts – Retrieves account data from VegaVend.
  • https://vegavend.com/wp-json/vegavend-store-api/v1/update-account – Updates account data between the Seller and Vegavend Marketplace.

Please ensure that you have the necessary permissions and agreements in place to share data with these endpoints.

Privacy Policy

By using this plugin, you agree to the following privacy policies:

  • Data collected by this plugin is used solely for the purpose of integrating and synchronizing your WooCommerce store with the VegaVend marketplace.
  • Data sent to and received from VegaVend endpoints is handled securely and in accordance with VegaVend’s privacy policy.
  • No personal data is stored or shared by this plugin beyond what is necessary for the integration and synchronization process.

For more information, please review the VegaVend Privacy Policy.

Conditions of Use and Sale

By using this plugin, you agree to the following conditions of use and sale:

  • You are responsible for ensuring that your use of this plugin complies with all applicable laws and regulations.
  • VegaVend is not responsible for any loss or damage resulting from your use of this plugin.
  • You agree to indemnify and hold VegaVend harmless from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of this plugin.

For more information, please review the VegaVend Conditions of Use and Sale.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/vegavend-merchant-connector directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the VegaVend Connector settings page in your WordPress admin and enter your VegaVend Store ID to connect your account with your website.
sections.faq:
How do I get started with VegaVend?

To get started with VegaVend, follow these steps:
1. Create a VegaVend Vendor Account by visiting Become a Vendor.
2. Set up your store on VegaVend by verifying your ID, address, company registration number and if applicable your VAT number.
3. Add your payment account to receive payments.
4. Setup your shipping methods in your Seller Dashboard.
4. Optionally, verify your social media accounts to boost consumer confidence.
5. Access your VegaVend Seller Dashboard to manage account verifications, shipping rates and your payment account.

How do I configure the plugin?

After setting up your VegaVend account:
1. Go to the VegaVend Connector settings page in your WordPress admin.
2. Enter your VegaVend Store ID to connect your account with your website.
3. Complete any outstanding tasks.
4. Configure product synchronization settings as needed.
5. Go to your product catagories and match them with VegaVend’s.
6. Add the product GTIN’s to each product

Where can I get support?

If you need further assistance, please contact our support team:
– Visit our Support Center
– Email us at support@vegavend.com

1.0.14

  • Improved product export performance
  • Enhanced resilience to plugin conflicts

1.0.13

  • Added logic to disable lock that prevented products from cron sync
  • Bump version to 1.0.13

1.0.12

  • Added a check to prevent sync errors
  • Added logic to set product default Sync settings based on the settings selected in Settings

1.0.11

  • Fixed store ID being cached and preventing a new connection

1.0.10

  • Fix error if WooCommerce is not active
  • Fix critical error if there are a large number of products.
  • Improved account synchronization

1.0.9

  • Fix error caused by cron stock sync

1.0.8

  • Added dynamic cron schedual based on number of products
  • Added daily cron stock synchronization
  • Added an alert for invalid Store ID or subscription

1.0.7

  • Removed logs

1.0.6

  • Added cancel cron jobs

1.0.5

  • Minor tweaks for cron schedual

1.0.4

  • Added VegaVend Accounts Page
  • Added Task Helper
  • Improved sync via cron functionality

1.0.3

  • Minor change for setup

1.0.2

  • Minor change for setup and added assets.

1.0.1

  • Minor change for setup.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of the VegaVend Merchant Connector plugin.
